standings.blurb: Seven straight wins. 8-3, a league-best 1,436.2 points and a 102-41 all-play record that's 13 wins better than anybody else's. Hung the week-high 153.7 on Aaron Rodgers LSD with CeeDee Lamb going for 30.2 and Chris Olave adding 19.2 in his first game since the trade. 100% playoff odds, 28.5% for the No. 1 seed. Still No. 1.

Five straight wins and the hottest team in the league over the last three weeks (143.4 a game). Dropped 126.46 on the No. 1 seed with Javonte Williams (24.1) and Patrick Mahomes (24.96) doing the damage. 8-3, locked in at 100%, and the best rest-of-season roster on the board.

The most frustrating team in the league. 1,357.1 points (third-most), an 89-54 all-play record (second-best), and a 5-6 record after scoring 87.86 and losing to the worst-scoring team in the league. Luck is −1.85 wins. Seed 7, 57.6% odds, and Week 12 is the Uck Bowl against the team right behind them.

Beat The anomaly's 129.66 to 117.76 behind Travis Kelce's 25.4, climbed into the 8th seed, and then flipped David Montgomery and an injured Davante Adams for Jaylen Warren early Tuesday morning. Second-best rest-of-season roster (923) and 79.2% playoff odds. Dangerous.

9-2 and the No. 1 seed, and they look like hell. 67.08 against Vert, a last-three average of 95.8, and Jared Goff's 20.36 sat on the bench while Tyler Shough started. Luck is +2.46 wins, the most in the league. Still 51.2% to finish first, which says more about the schedule than the roster.

Rat smoked Big Dabolls 119.1 to 48.24, and the new guy did his job: DJ Moore scored 23.1 in his first game since the Olave trade. 6-5, the 6th seed, 84.5% playoff odds and 7-4 against the weekly median. Next up: The Man vs The Mouse.

Scored 48.24. That's the lowest score in league history. Laquon Treadwell started at flex and scored zero, and the best lineup on the roster would've scored 65.64. Somehow still 7-4, the 4th seed, and 99.0% to make the playoffs. Ranked this low because of how they're playing, not where they sit.

Three straight losses. Scored 117.76, more than half the league, and lost anyway to Goobz. 5-6, the 10th seed, and 25.1% playoff odds. They've had 1,313.6 points scored against them, third-most in the league. Need the Living Room Bowl against the hottest team in the league.

Scored 127.34, the third-highest score of the week, and lost by 26.36 because they drew the O'Dons. Jonah Coleman went for 34.9 in a loss. Justin Herbert's 22.44 sat on the bench while Caleb Williams started and scored 14.34. 6-5, the 5th seed, 79.1% odds, and a 65-78 all-play record says the record is generous.

71.5 against The Park. That's Trust The Process's worst score of the season, with Jaxon Smith-Njigba on bye and Bo Nix managing 11.5. Even the best possible lineup was 72.2. Fell out of the top 8 to the 9th seed at 5-6, 51.5% odds, and the Man vs The Mouse decides a lot.

Won 109.66 to 87.4 and still left 29.8 points on the bench, the worst bench job of the week: Mike Evans' 22.9 sat while the Buccaneers D/ST started and scored −1. 3-8, 0.4% playoff odds, and 1,367.7 points against, the most in the league.

Beat Trust The Process 101.6 to 71.5 with George Pickens (23.8) and Parker Washington (18.3), even with Brock Bowers starting at flex and scoring zero while Justice Hill dropped 17.6 on the bench. 3-8 and 1.7% odds, but the Corporate Bowl is up next.

Dak Prescott scored 35.9, the best individual score of the week, and the team still lost 109.66 to 87.4. Antonio Williams scored 21.2 on the bench. 2-9 on a 69-74 all-play record, luck of −3.31 wins, the worst in the league, and 0.0% playoff odds.

The worst points total in the league (1,040.5) and the worst all-play record (47-96), and somehow 5-6 after beating The Overload 99.12 to 87.86. Cam Ward (22.22) and Ladd McConkey (20.7) carried it. 11th seed, 21.9% odds. Luckiest bad team in America.

previews.take: The Living Room Bowl. Zach leads the series 2-1, and John Francis won the Week 4 meeting by 2.74. The O'Dons project 137.6 to 112.4, a 25.2-point spread, 77% Zach. Joe Burrow (24.8) and Bucky Irving (21.0) lead the O'Dons, and Jahmyr Gibbs (25.6) has to go nuclear for The anomaly's, who are 5-6, have lost three straight and need this badly.

The Battle For The Park. Ben leads 3-2 and won Week 4, 101.88 to 92.30. Big Dabolls are coming off the lowest score in league history (48.24) and still project 125.5 to 101.6, 76% Ben. Trevor Lawrence (23.3) and Cam Skattebo (17.4) for Ben, Dak Prescott (19.5) for Danny. Danny's playoff odds are 0.0%, so a rivalry upset is the whole season now.

The Keyboard Bowl. lukas leads 2-1, including a 3.24-point win in the 2025 semis. The DBC's project 109.5 to 92.8, 69% lukas, but they just scored 67.08 and are carrying Puka Nacua and Davante Adams on IR. Bhayshul Tuten (18.6, questionable) leads the DBC's, Matthew Stafford (15.3) leads Jalen rams me. Brighton is 5-6 and needs it more.

The Cardio Bowl. Vert lead the series 4-2 and won Week 4 by 73.9. Vert project 142.3, the best on the board, to 117.3, 77% Vert. Ja'Marr Chase (25.9) and Patrick Mahomes (18.5) against Jayden Daniels (22.5) and Ashton Jeanty (15.3). Alex is 3-8 and playing for pride. Vert are playing for a bye.

The Corporate Bowl. Matthew leads 5-2, Holden won Week 4 82.46 to 61.82 in one of the ugliest games ever played here. The Park project 116.7 to 111.8, 56% Matthew, with Parker Washington (17.7) and Kirk Cousins (17.4) on top. Justin Herbert (16.2) is questionable for LSD and Tee Higgins (17.2) leads them. Holden is the 5th seed and can't afford to drop this.

The Man vs The Mouse, and the game of the week. John leads the series 5-2 with a 2024 championship win on the résumé, but Elijah took Week 4, 144.12 to 120.82. Rat project 118.6 to 115.3, 54% Elijah. Kenneth Walker III (22.0, questionable) and Brock Purdy (18.8) for Rat, Jaxon Smith-Njigba (21.6) back from bye with Chase Brown (16.7) for Trust The Process. Rat are the 6th seed, TTP the 9th. Loser has a very bad week.

The Uck Bowl, and it's basically a play-in game. Bosefski leads the league's most-played rivalry 6-4 and has won three straight. Goobz (8th seed) project 132.8 to 117.0 for The Overload (7th seed), 68% Goobz. C.J. Stroud (21.4) and Justin Jefferson (20.1) against Josh Allen (18.7) and Christian McCaffrey (18.1). Both teams are 5-6. Winner sleeps in the top 8.

headlines.title: 48.24. The lowest score in league history.
headlines.dek: Big Dabolls set a new all-time low against Rat, and even Ben Frey's best possible lineup would have lost by 53.
body: Ben Frey's Big Dabolls scored 48.24 points in Week 11. That's the lowest score in the league's record books, breaking Danny Stevens' 50.6 from Week 6 of 2022. Rat won 119.1 to 48.24, a 70.86-point beating and the biggest margin of the week.

Look at this lineup. Laquon Treadwell started at flex and scored zero. DK Metcalf: 1.2. Luther Burden III: 3.3. Isaiah Likely: 4.5. Cam Skattebo: 5.8. Jonathan Taylor: 6.7. Trevor Lawrence led the team with 12.74. Devaughn Vele scored 14.6 on the bench, more than any starter Ben played. And it doesn't even matter: the best lineup on the whole roster would have scored 65.64.

The insane part? Big Dabolls are still 7-4, still the 4th seed and still 99.0% to make the playoffs. Ben clinched a spot in the record book and probably a spot in the bracket the same week. Next up is the Battle For The Park against Danny, the guy whose record he just took.

headlines.title: Rivalry Week is here. All seven of them.
headlines.dek: Every Week 12 game is a designated rivalry, and three of them have playoff spots riding on them.
body: Every single game in Week 12 is a rivalry game. The headliner is The Man vs The Mouse: Rat (6-5, 6th seed) against Trust The Process (5-6, 9th seed). John leads the series 5-2 and beat Elijah in the 2024 championship, but Elijah took Week 4 this year, 144.12 to 120.82. Rat project 118.6, TTP 115.3. Fifty-four percent Elijah. It's a coin flip with a grudge attached.

The Uck Bowl is a straight-up play-in game. The Overload (7th seed) and Team Goobz (8th seed) are both 5-6, Bosefski leads the league's most-played rivalry 6-4, and Goobz project 132.8 to 117.0. The Corporate Bowl has Holden's 5th-seeded LSD against Matthew's Park, projected 116.7 to 111.8 for The Park. Matthew leads that series 5-2 and would love nothing more than to wreck Holden's seed.

The rest: Zach (137.6) against John Francis (112.4) in the Living Room Bowl, Vert (142.3) against A-Rock (117.3) in the Cardio Bowl, Ben (125.5) against Danny (101.6) in the Battle For The Park, and lukas (109.5) against Brighton (92.8) in the Keyboard Bowl. Seven games, seven grudges, one week. Set your lineups, you cowards.

headlines.title: Seven straight. The O'Dons are the best team in this league.
headlines.dek: 153.7 points, the week's high, and the longest active win streak in the league.
body: The Fighting O'Dons scored 153.7 against Aaron Rodgers LSD, the highest score of Week 11, and won their seventh straight game. That ties Alex Reese and Ben Frey for the second-longest win streak in league history, two behind Brighton Caushaj's 9. CeeDee Lamb scored 30.2, Chris Olave scored 19.2 in his first game since the trade, and Breece Hall and Bucky Irving put up 19 apiece.
Zach is 8-3 with 1,436.2 points, the most in the league, and a 102-41 all-play record that's 13 wins better than anybody else's. Playoff odds: 100%. No. 1 seed odds: 28.5%.

Holden deserves a moment of silence. LSD scored 127.34, the third-highest score of the week, and lost by 26.36. Jonah Coleman scored 34.9 in a losing effort. That's what happens when you draw the O'Dons.

headlines.title: Five teams at 5-6, and Trust The Process just fell out of the top 8
headlines.dek: Seeds 7 through 11 are all 5-6. Three weeks left.
body: The Park beat Trust The Process 101.6 to 71.5, TTP's worst score of the season. Jaxon Smith-Njigba was on bye and Bo Nix managed 11.5, and even the best possible lineup on the roster would have scored 72.2. TTP fell from 8th to 9th. The Overload lost 99.12 to 87.86 to Jalen rams me, the lowest-scoring team in the league, and dropped from 6th to 7th. Team Goobz beat The anomaly's and jumped from 10th to 8th.

By ESPN's seeds, it's The Overload 7th, Goobz 8th, TTP 9th, The anomaly's 10th and Jalen rams me 11th, all at 5-6. Our 20,000 simulations: Goobz 79.2%, Overload 57.6%, TTP 51.5%, anomaly 25.1%, Jalen 21.9%. Above them, Aaron Rodgers LSD (79.1%) and Rat (84.5%) are 6-5 and not safe either.

At the top, Vert dropped 126.46 on the No. 1 seed and won their fifth straight. The DBC's scored 67.08 and are still 9-2 and the No. 1 seed, with 51.2% odds to stay there. The O'Dons are at 28.5% and Vert 19.6%.

headlines.title: Alex Reese won by 22 and still left 29.8 points on the bench
headlines.dek: Mike Evans scored 22.9 on the bench while the Buccaneers D/ST started and scored −1.
body: A-Rock Balls beat Stone Cold Dons 109.66 to 87.4, which is great, because otherwise this would be a felony. Mike Evans scored 22.9 on the bench. Xavier Worthy scored 11.8 on the bench. The Ravens D/ST scored 9 on the bench while the Buccaneers D/ST started and scored −1. The best lineup would have scored 139.46. That's 29.8 points left on the table, the worst bench job of Week 11.

The Park won too, no thanks to the lineup: Brock Bowers started at flex and scored zero while Justice Hill dropped 17.6 on the bench. Holden started Caleb Williams (14.34) over Justin Herbert (22.44). And Danny Stevens left Antonio Williams' 21.2 on the bench in a game where Dak Prescott scored 35.9, the best individual score of the week. None of those benchings flipped a result. They just look terrible.

headlines.title: Goobz cash two vets for Jaylen Warren and grab a B+
headlines.dek: Team Goobz turn Davante Adams and David Montgomery into Jaylen Warren for a B+ (+12.2), while the 9-1 DBC's settle for a C+ (-1.2).
body: Trade No. 63 hit at 3 a.m. Tuesday, and Team Goobz played it like a front office that's sick of roster clutter. They shipped Davante Adams and David Montgomery to The DBC's for Jaylen Warren, a two-for-one consolidation that projects to win them lineup points every week from here. Warren's rest-of-season projection is 103.4. Adams sits at 81.5 and Montgomery at 76.0.
That's +12.2 and a B+ for Goobz. The DBC's get two names and a C+ (-1.2), which is basically a wash for a 9-1 team that didn't need to blink. Adams had a Week 11 bye, and Montgomery put up 15.4.

headlines.title: Rat flip Chris Olave into DJ Moore plus a TE fix
headlines.dek: Rat land DJ Moore, Chig Okonkwo and Terrance Ferguson for Chris Olave and a B+ (+20.6); the Fighting O'Dons get a C+ (-0.3).
body: Rat finally won a trade, and it wasn't close. Trade No. 62 sent Chris Olave to the Fighting O'Dons for DJ Moore, Chig Okonkwo and Terrance Ferguson. The tight end piece is what makes it: Okonkwo put up 10.6 in Week 11 and projects 69.4 the rest of the way, and Rat's lineup needed that bad. Moore scored 23.1 in Week 11, Olave 19.2.

Olave still projects higher than Moore (104.6 to 94.3), so the O'Dons don't get robbed, just a C+ at -0.3. Ferguson projects 0.0 and is already back on waivers. Rat take a B+ (+20.6) and climb off a ledger that sat at -114.0.

headlines.title: The Park buy Kirk Cousins with Rome Odunze, grade B+
headlines.dek: The Park land Kirk Cousins for Rome Odunze and earn a B+ (+16.8); Vert get a C+ (+0.8) for moving a backup QB.
body: The Park had a quarterback problem, and Trade No. 61 fixed it. Drake Maye projects 0.0 the rest of the way, so The Park sent Rome Odunze to Vert for Kirk Cousins, whose 113.3 rest-of-season projection makes him their starter. Cousins scored 7.4 in Week 11; Odunze scored 8.5.

That's +16.8 and a B+ for The Park. Vert get a C+ (+0.8) for cashing in a QB who was never sitting ahead of Patrick Mahomes. Odunze projects 74.4 the rest of the way, which adds receiver depth for Vert without moving their starting lineup much.

rings.blurb: Before ESPN kept the receipts, Zach O'Donoghue beat Alex Reese for the 2021 title. No box scores survive, just the ring. A year later he did it again to the same guy, which makes Zach the league's only two-time champ and Alex the first manager to lose two finals.
Back-to-back. Same final, same victim: Zach beat Alex Reese again, this time by 70.1, the biggest title-game beatdown on record. By our all-time rankings it's still the best season anyone has had.

Zach's two-year reign is over. A .500 Ben Frey team went all-in at midseason, pried CeeDee Lamb loose from Holden Wright, and rode him to the league's first new champion. Lamb dropped 40.2 in the final and Ben won it by 4.16. Ballsy as hell, and it paid off.

Trust the process, literally. The unluckiest team in the league that year (2.9 wins below what its scores earned) snuck in as the 7 seed and then went nuclear. 178.48 in the final is the highest-scoring title game on record. Process complete. Elijah lost his second straight final.

In 2024 Trevor finished dead last, posted the worst season in league history, and served the league punishment. One year later he took a 6-8 team, grabbed the 7 seed and won the whole damn thing. Stevenson put up 27.2 in the final. From punishment to champion in twelve months.

rivalries.blurb: The grudge with a ring in it. John beat Elijah in the 2024 championship, 178.48 to 163.66, and in the 2022 third-place game, where Rat put up a historically sad 22.48. Elijah got one back in Week 4 this year, 144.12 to 120.82. Week 12 decides who gets to talk.

rivalries.blurb: Matthew owns this one, 5-2, including both postseason meetings. Holden finally won in Week 4 this year, 82.46 to 61.82, in one of the ugliest games the league has ever seen: 144.28 combined points. Both of these teams should be embarrassed.

rivalries.blurb: Zach leads 2-1, and the one that hurts is the 2025 playoff game: Zach dropped 172.56 and buried John Francis by 68.6. John Francis got revenge in Week 4 this year by 2.74, 140.56 to 137.82. Week 12 is the rubber match.

archive.title: Why even draft, Danny?
archive.dek: Half the Stone Cold Dons roster came off the waiver wire, two of Danny Stevens' 15 picks are left, and he's 2-8.
body: Danny Stevens spent 15 picks in August. Two are still here: Dak Prescott, and Ryan Flournoy, whom Danny cut in September and claimed back off waivers in October. Amon-Ra St. Brown, his first-rounder, plays for Vert. Omarion Hampton, his second, plays for Trust The Process. Eight of the 16 players on the Stone Cold Dons were never drafted by anybody: Keon Coleman, Antonio Williams, Audric Estime, Corey Kiner, Omar Cooper Jr., Spencer Shrader and two waiver-wire defenses. That's the most in the league. The record is 2-8.
"Draft day's more of a suggestion," a league source said.

Danny isn't alone at the waiver window. A-Rock Balls (2-8), Big Dabolls and Rat each carry six undrafted players, and The anomaly's have five. Ben Frey somehow turned his into 7-3, so that's one person it's working for. Alex has Aaron Rodgers, Tyler Bass and Cade Otton off the wire, and the most points allowed in the league (1,280.3).

Compare The Overload: 15 of Trevor Illson's 17 players were drafted by somebody, and 11 are his own picks. He just scored 173.34. The DBC's still have 10 of their picks and are 9-1. Turns out the draft counts.

archive.title: Mahomes settles Vert's QB debate in a 159.22 rout of Rat
archive.dek: Rat's 124.46 would have beaten eight teams in Week 10. Vert's would have beaten twelve.
body: Vert spent part of October refusing to name a starting quarterback. In Week 10, Patrick Mahomes scored 35.42 while Kirk Cousins put up 15.38 on the bench, and Ja'Marr Chase (34.10), Amon-Ra St. Brown (25.80) and kicker Cam Little (19.00) handled the rest. The 159.22 was the week's second-highest score, and Vert sit 7-3.

Rat had the bad luck to be across the field. Emmett Johnson went for 35.10 and Brock Purdy added 31.66, and Rat still lost by 34.76. They fall to 5-5, one of four .500 teams in a scrum for the last playoff spots. "We did everything right except the schedule," a team source said.

archive.title: 173.34: The Overload hang the season's high score and bury A-Rock by 82.58
archive.dek: Christian McCaffrey went for 46.3, Chuba Hubbard for 34.2, and Trevor Illson's 5-5 team is suddenly at 95.7% to make the playoffs.
body: Holy hell. Christian McCaffrey dropped 46.3, Chuba Hubbard added 34.2, Josh Allen 22.34 and Stefon Diggs 20.3, and The Overload put up 173.34, the highest score anybody has posted this season. The old 2026 high was Vert's 161.6 from Week 4. It missed the league's all-time top five by six hundredths of a point.

A-Rock Balls scored 90.76 and lost by 82.58, the fourth-biggest blowout in league history. And The Overload could have made it worse: Alvin Kamara's 16.4 sat on the bench, and the best possible lineup was 183.54.

Trevor Illson is only 5-5, but the 85-45 all-play record is second in the league, and the luck number (−1.54) says the record should be better. Three straight wins, playoff odds up from 86.0% to 95.7%. A-Rock is 2-8 and at 0.1%.

archive.title: Trust The Process were 11% to win. They won by 1.00.
archive.dek: Projected for 82.5 and a 38.1-point underdog, TTP scored 123.4 and beat The anomaly's 122.4, with 32.8 points sitting on their own bench.
body: Last week's preview gave Trust The Process 11% odds. Jaxon Smith-Njigba ignored it with 31.1, Chase Brown put up 28.3, and backup quarterback Drew Lock threw in 15.6 with Bo Nix not playing. Final: 123.4 to 122.4. Jahmyr Gibbs dropped 44.2 for The anomaly's and it still wasn't enough.

TTP nearly blew it anyway. Omarion Hampton (17.5) and Josh Downs (15.3), both acquired Tuesday, sat on the bench while Rhamondre Stevenson (1.5) and Tucker Kraft (2.9) started. The best possible lineup was 145.5. Win by 1, learn nothing.

The anomaly's have their own regret. On Saturday they shipped Derrick Henry, Deebo Samuel and Blake Corum to the Stone Cold Dons, and the three combined for 65.8 points against The Park. Matthew Golden, who came back in the deal, scored 12. TTP's playoff odds jumped from 36.9% to 72.2%. The anomaly's fell from 70.8% to 53.6% and drop to ninth, one spot out, on the league's head-to-head tiebreaker.

archive.title: Henry delivers, the Dons end the skid, and The Park benched the win
archive.dek: Drake Maye started and scored 3.02. Deshaun Watson scored 21.38 on The Park's bench. The Park lost by 9.30.
body: Derrick Henry needed 9.71 on Monday night and put up 19. The Stone Cold Dons beat The Park 137.42 to 128.12 and snapped a seven-game losing streak that started in Week 3. The three veterans they bought Saturday combined for 65.8, and Dak Prescott added 34.42.

Now the crime. The Park started Drake Maye (3.02) over Deshaun Watson (21.38). That one swap was worth 18.36 points, and The Park lost by 9.30. Do the math. George Pickens went for 43.5 and Parker Washington 28.2, and they got wasted on a quarterback decision. The best possible Park lineup was 150.78. The Park is 2-8 with four straight losses.

The Dons won with the week's biggest bench crime anyway: 39.3 points left behind. The Vikings D/ST scored 21 on the bench while the Bills D/ST started for 10, and Ryan Flournoy (19.1) and Mark Andrews (16.2) sat while Omar Cooper Jr. started and scored 0. At 2-8 with a 66-64 all-play record, the Dons are still the unluckiest team in the league at −3.08 wins.

archive.title: DBC's hold off Goobz by 4.18 and go 9-1, and Goobz lose by about four again
archive.dek: Team Goobz's best lineup was 103.94, enough to win. They started Travis Kelce (5) over Pat Freiermuth (11.5).
body: Lukas Bosefski's DBC's beat Christopher Bosefski's Team Goobz 100.62 to 96.44. Jared Goff (20.42) and Bhayshul Tuten (20.3) carried it, and Jaylen Warren added 9.1 on Sunday night. Five straight wins, and No. 1 seed odds are up from 51.7% to 63.6%.

Goobz lost by 4.12 last week with 14.5 on the bench. This week they lost by 4.18 with a best possible lineup of 103.94. Travis Kelce started and scored 5 while Pat Freiermuth scored 11.5 on the bench. The 49ers D/ST went for −1 and Tyler Allgeier for 1.4. Goobz are 4-6, three straight losses, and their playoff odds fell from 64.2% to 52.1%.
The DBC's luck is +2.54 wins, the most in the league, and the bill might come due Sunday: they project 86.8 against Vert's 126.8. Puka Nacua is on IR and the Seahawks D/ST projects for zero.

archive.title: Big Dabolls flatten LSD 144.18 to 82.06, and the bubble is four teams at 5-5
archive.dek: Isaiah Likely 27.7, Cam Skattebo 27.2, Trevor Lawrence 26.78. Aaron Rodgers LSD posted the week's lowest score.
body: Ben Frey's Big Dabolls beat Aaron Rodgers LSD by 62.12, the second-biggest margin of the week, with three guys over 26. Big Dabolls are 7-3 at 99.6% playoff odds. LSD's 82.06 was the week's low, and they're 6-4 on a 54-76 all-play record. Their luck is +1.85 wins, and their odds dropped from 86.9% to 75.4%.

The O'Dons keep rolling: 120.76 to 85.96 over Jalen rams me, Joe Burrow 33.16, six straight wins. Vert hung 159.22 on Rat behind Patrick Mahomes (35.42) and Ja'Marr Chase (34.1). The top five seeds right now: DBC's 9-1, then O'Dons, Vert and Big Dabolls at 7-3, then LSD at 6-4.

Then the mess. The Overload, Rat, Trust The Process and The anomaly's are all 5-5, and this league breaks ties by head-to-head record, not points. On ESPN's seeds, The Overload is sixth, Rat seventh and TTP eighth, and The anomaly's are ninth and on the outside. Four weeks left. Team Goobz (4-6) sits at 52.1% odds.

archive.title: Rivalry Week is one week out: all seven grudge matches hit in Week 12
archive.dek: Every designated rivalry plays in Week 12. Here's where the series stand, and which ones have playoff spots on the line.
body: The Man vs The Mouse: John Reese leads Elijah Dembe 5-2 and beat him in the 2024 championship, but Elijah won the first meeting this year 144.12 to 120.82. Both teams are 5-5, TTP is in at No. 7 and Rat is out on points. The Uck Bowl, the most-played rivalry at 10 games, has Christopher Bosefski up 6-4 on Trevor Illson after a 113.18 to 110.32 Goobz win in Week 4. The Corporate Bowl: Matthew Reese leads 5-2, but Holden Wright won Week 4 82.46 to 61.82.

The Living Room Bowl: Zach O'Donoghue leads John Francis 2-1, and John Francis took Week 4 140.56 to 137.82. The Battle For The Park: Ben Frey leads Danny Stevens 3-2, and the 2-8 Dons get the 7-3 Big Dabolls. The Cardio Bowl: Samuel Vert leads Alex Reese 4-2 and won Week 4 161.6 to 87.68. The Keyboard Bowl: Lukas Bosefski leads Brighton Caushaj 2-1 after a 128.14 to 107.32 Week 4 win.
Week 11 first, and it matters: Trust The Process gets The Park, The anomaly's get Goobz and Rat gets Big Dabolls. Lose this week and you walk into your rivalry game needing it.

archive.title: Charbonnet boomerang pays off: Jalen rams me grabs an A-
archive.dek: Jalen rams me gets an A- (+23.0) for buying back Zach Charbonnet with Jordyn Tyson, and the Fighting O'Dons eat a C- (-8.6) for Breece Hall.
body: Trade No. 57 is graded, and Brighton Caushaj just landed his best grade since Trade No. 43. Jalen rams me sent Breece Hall to the Fighting O'Dons on Nov. 10 for Zach Charbonnet, the back he'd traded them four days earlier, plus Jordyn Tyson. Tyson dropped 19.0 in Week 10 and Charbonnet added 9.4. Hall put up 14.8 for the O'Dons.

Rest of the way, Charbonnet (93.3) and Tyson (92.6) both project higher than Hall (89.6). That's +23.0 lineup points and an A- for Jalen rams me, and a C- (-8.6) for Zach O'Donoghue. He still tops the trade ledger at +102.9, but he got fleeced on this one.

archive.title: Stone Cold Dons need 9.71 from Derrick Henry to end seven-game skid
archive.dek: The 1-8 Dons trail The Park 128.12 to 118.42, and the running back they acquired Saturday is the only player left in the game.
body: Derrick Henry arrived in Saturday's 3-for-2 with The anomaly’s and goes Monday night needing 9.71 points to snap a seven-game losing streak; 9.70 gets a tie. He averages 15.8 a game, and ESPN projects him for 18.2. The other two veterans from the deal already showed up: Deebo Samuel had 25.9 and Blake Corum 20.9. "We bought him for exactly this," a team source said.

The Park has nobody left and one decision to live with: Drake Maye started and scored 3.02 while Deshaun Watson put up 21.38 on the bench. The Dons have their own, with the Vikings D/ST's 21 sitting behind the Bills' 10. Everything else is settled or close to it. Trust The Process beat The anomaly’s by 1.00, the DBC's held off Goobz by 4.18, and Monday's other holdouts, Justin Herbert and Zay Flowers, are chasing deficits of 78.38 and 46.16.

archive.title: Top-seeded DBC's trail Goobz by 4.92, need Jaylen Warren on SNF
archive.dek: Three games sit within ten points heading into prime time, and two of them run through Bengals-Steelers.
body: The league's best team is losing to family. Lukas Bosefski's 8-1 DBC's trail Christopher Bosefski's Team Goobz 96.44 to 91.52, and Goobz are finished for the week. Jaylen Warren, projected for 15.53, needs 4.93 tonight. "He can do that on one carry," a DBC's source said, which is true and also not a plan.

Fighting O'Dons trail Jalen rams me 85.96 to 82.20 but still have Joe Burrow and Rico Dowdle, 28.79 projected combined. Stone Cold Dons trail The Park 128.12 to 118.42 and need 9.71 from Derrick Henry, acquired this weekend, on Monday night.

Vert leads Rat 125.12 to 108.06 with Ja'Marr Chase still to play. Chase Brown needs 27.31 to save Trust The Process against the anomaly's. The Overload (173.34) and Big Dabolls (121.78 to 49.20) can change the channel.

archive.title: Gibbs drops 44.2; Vert's stars are still to come
archive.dek: With the early games in the fourth quarter, Goobz lead the 8-1 DBC's and Vert has barely started.
body: As of 3:30 p.m., Jahmyr Gibbs is final at 44.2 and The anomaly’s lead Trust The Process 93.58 to 45.40. TTP still has Jaxon Smith-Njigba and Drew Lock at 4:05 and Chase Brown tonight, projected to lose 123.12 to 101.47. Josh Downs has 15.3 on the TTP bench. Rhamondre Stevenson started and has 1.5.
Vert leads Rat 70.74 to 61.10 behind Patrick Mahomes (29.34) and hasn't played Ja'Marr Chase, Kyren Williams, Javonte Williams or George Kittle yet. Projection: 158.36 to 113.99.

The one to watch is Goobz, up 75.32 to 46.52 on the DBC's, who have Trey McBride, Konata Mumpfield, the Seahawks defense and Jaylen Warren left. Projected 112.88 to 101.83. Pick: Goobz. "We'd like Jason Myers to kick a lot," a team source said.

archive.title: Stone Cold Dons buy Henry, Deebo and Corum; anomaly’s get Golden
archive.dek: The 1-8 Dons take on three veterans in a 3-for-2, and The anomaly’s consolidate around Matthew Golden’s 17.6 points a game.
body: The anomaly’s sent Derrick Henry (15.8 points a game), Deebo Samuel Sr. (12.1) and Blake Corum (10.5) to Stone Cold Dons on Saturday for Matthew Golden (17.6) and Courtland Sutton (7.1). Sutton is now on his third new team in 11 days: Trust The Process to Big Dabolls on Nov. 3, Big Dabolls to the Dons on Nov. 10, and now here.

The Dons put all three newcomers straight into the Week 10 lineup, Henry and Deebo in their usual spots and Corum at flex. None has played yet, and the Dons trail The Park 56.92 to 23.8 while riding a seven-game losing streak. Golden has 12 points so far for The anomaly’s, who lead Trust The Process 93.58 to 45.4. Sutton, projected for zero, went to the bench. “He’s unpacking one bag at a time,” a league source said.

archive.title: Trust The Process sends Jameson Williams to Brighton for Downs and Hampton
archive.dek: Brighton Caushaj's 27th trade of the season brings back a receiver he owned for one day in October.
body: Trust The Process traded Jameson Williams to Jalen rams me on Tuesday for wide receiver Josh Downs and running back Omarion Hampton. Williams is averaging 13.2 a game; Downs (8.3) and Hampton (8.5) add up to 16.8. It's Williams' second stint with Brighton. The first lasted one day: Brighton got him from The Park on Oct. 13 and shipped him to the O'Dons on Oct. 14, in the deal that brought Hampton in.

Hampton goes straight into John Reese's lineup at running back, projected for 7.9 against The anomaly’s, with TreVeyon Henderson out and Rhamondre Stevenson questionable. Downs (9.2) opens on the bench. Williams starts at receiver for Brighton, projected for 12.1 Sunday against the 6-3 O'Dons. "Jameson knows the building," a team source said. "He's seen the lobby."

archive.title: Big Dabolls flip Sutton after one week, land Judkins from Stone Cold Dons
archive.dek: Ben Frey sent Courtland Sutton and Jadarian Price to the 1-8 Stone Cold Dons on Tuesday for running back Quinshon Judkins.
body: The deal went through at 1:26 p.m. Tuesday. Big Dabolls get Judkins, who is averaging 11.5 points a game and scored 5.5 in Week 9 for Danny Stevens. The Stone Cold Dons get Price, averaging 5.3, and Sutton, whom Frey acquired from Trust The Process on Nov. 3 for Eli Raridon. Sutton spent his one week with Big Dabolls on the bench and scored 15.5 there.

Judkins goes straight into Big Dabolls' flex, projected for 11.8 Sunday against Aaron Rodgers LSD in a game between 6-3 teams. Price starts at running back for the Stone Cold Dons, projected for 11.9 against The Park. Sutton is projected for zero this week and sits on another bench. "He's a great route runner," a Stone Cold source said. "We'll see him in Week 11."

archive.title: Brighton buys Charbonnet back from Sunday's opponent, ships out Breece Hall
archive.dek: Four days after trading Zach Charbonnet to the Fighting O'Dons, Jalen rams me got him back, plus Jordyn Tyson, for Breece Hall. The two teams play each other Sunday.
body: Trade No. 26 for Brighton Caushaj is a return. Jalen rams me sent Charbonnet to Zach O'Donoghue on Nov. 6 for Matthew Stafford and Michael Pittman Jr. On Tuesday it bought him back, with WR Jordyn Tyson, for Breece Hall, who had been on the roster for five days and scored 11.7 in his only start. Charbonnet scored 9.6 on the O'Dons' bench in between.

The lineup math gets settled Sunday, when the 6-3 O'Dons play the 4-5 Jalen rams me. ESPN projects Charbonnet for 14.4 and Tyson for 8.6 in Brighton's flex. Hall slots in next to Rico Dowdle at 12.1 for an O'Dons backfield with Bucky Irving and Saquon Barkley both projected for zero. "We know Zach," a team source said. "We've had him twice."

archive.title: Injury report: Puka, Michael Wilson and half of Brighton's roster
archive.dek: Forty-five players on league rosters carry an injury tag heading into Week 10, and two of the league's best receivers have zero projected points left.
body: The DBC's have the biggest hole. Puka Nacua is listed doubtful and is still in lukas bosefski's starting lineup after 173.6 points at 24.8 a game, and ESPN projects him for zero the rest of the way. Holden Wright is in the same spot with Michael Wilson: out, 120.7 points at 13.4 a game, zero projected. He's part of an LSD infirmary that runs six deep, with DeVonta Smith, Kyle Monangai, Treylon Burks and two running backs on IR.

Jalen rams me also lists six. Josh Jacobs (14.6 a game) and Kyler Murray are out, A.J. Brown is out and still in the starting lineup, Ladd McConkey is questionable, and Michael Pittman Jr. arrived in this morning's trade already carrying an IR tag. Trust The Process is starting Rhamondre Stevenson (113.7 points) on a questionable tag with TreVeyon Henderson out behind him, and Vert's Patrick Mahomes is questionable with three Vert running backs ruled out.
"It's not a waiver wire anymore," a league source said. "It's a triage line."

archive.title: DBC's start the wrong quarterback, win by 33.72 anyway
archive.dek: Jared Goff scored 5.30 while Tyler Shough put up 19.70 on the bench, and lukas bosefski's team still beat Trust The Process 119.6 to 85.88.
body: The DBC's quarterback room is a coin flip, and lukas bosefski called it wrong. Goff was projected for 19.4 and scored 5.30. Shough scored 19.70 on the bench. It cost nothing: Puka Nacua went for 35.00, KC Concepcion added 18.8 at flex and Ka'imi Fairbairn kicked 17.00.

At 8-1, the DBC's are two games clear of four 6-3 teams, and the decision doesn't get easier. Goff averages 18.42 a game, Shough 18.20. “We'll pick one Saturday,” a team source said. “Probably.” Next up is Christopher Bosefski's 4-5 Team Goobz.

archive.title: 62.92: Brighton's brand-new lineup faceplants, and Big Dabolls win by 71.86 with 36 points on the bench
archive.dek: Jalen rams me posted the lowest score of Week 9 days after trading for three of its starters. Ben Frey benched a 36.18-point quarterback and still won the week's biggest blowout.
body: Holy hell, Brighton. Jalen rams me scored 62.92 against Big Dabolls, the lowest score in the league this week, and lost by 71.86. Josh Jacobs was projected for 16.6 and scored 0.5. Ladd McConkey, acquired Thursday and dropped straight into the lineup, was projected for 10.8 and scored zero. Not a typo. Zero. Even the perfect lineup only gets Brighton to 80.22.

And Ben barely needed his own starters. Jordan Love scored 36.18 on the Big Dabolls bench while Trevor Lawrence started and put up 13.58. Courtland Sutton added 15.5 on the bench. That's 32.2 points of bench crime, the worst in the league this week, and it didn't matter one bit because Christian Watson went for 30.1 and Luther Burden III, the guy Brighton traded away, dropped 20.7 on his old team. “We left a whole quarterback on the bench and still won by 70,” a team source said. “We're not apologizing.”
Big Dabolls are 6-3 with 92.8% playoff odds. Jalen rams me is 4-5 with a 41-76 all-play record, second-worst in the league, and 1.7% odds.

archive.title: Five straight: the O'Dons drop 152.04 and take over No. 1 in the power rankings
archive.dek: CeeDee Lamb, Joe Burrow and Bucky Irving combined for 91.54. The O'Dons are averaging 148.0 over the last three weeks and lead the league in points.
body: The Fighting O'Dons are on fire. They hung 152.04 on The Park, the high score of Week 9, behind CeeDee Lamb (33.5), Joe Burrow (29.54) and Bucky Irving (28.5). That's five straight wins, a league-best 84-33 all-play record and a league-high 1,161.8 points, now 22.8 more than the DBC's.

The DBC's are still 8-1 and won their fourth straight, 119.6 to 85.88 over Trust The Process, with Puka Nacua going for 35.0. But their No. 1 seed odds fell from 75.2% to 51.7% this week. The O'Dons are at 32.8%. They're two games back with five to play, and they lead the DBC's in points. “We're not chasing anybody,” a team source said. “We're just scoring 150 and letting the math do the trash talk.”
The O'Dons are No. 1 in the power rankings. Vert is No. 2 and the 8-1 DBC's are No. 3.

archive.title: Trust The Process falls out of the top 8, and Rat and The Overload climb in
archive.dek: Four teams are 4-5. Only The Overload is in, on points. TTP's playoff odds dropped from 63.5% to 36.9%, and it projects for 82.5 this week with no quarterback projected to score.
body: Week 9 reshuffled the bottom of the playoff line. Rat beat Team Goobz and jumped to 5-4 and the 7 seed, and its odds climbed from 37.5% to 59.8%. The Overload beat the anomaly’s 110.16 to 89.72 and holds the 8 seed at 4-5 on 1,095.9 points. Team Goobz (64.2%), Trust The Process (36.9%) and Jalen rams me (1.7%) are also 4-5, and all three are on the outside.

Trust The Process lost 119.6 to 85.88 and helped the DBC's do it. Shedeur Sanders scored 22.68 on the bench while Bo Nix started and scored 15.68. Joe Milton put up 13.16 on the bench too. Tucker Kraft started at tight end and scored 1.9 while Eli Raridon got 8.2 on the bench. The best lineup was 101.18. Still a loss, just a less embarrassing one.

It gets worse. Bo Nix and Sanders are both projected for zero this week, and TTP's best lineup projects 82.5 against the anomaly’s' 120.6. That's a 38.1-point spread and 11% win odds. Somebody find this man a quarterback.

archive.title: Goobz lose by 4.12 with 14.5 points on the bench
archive.dek: Team Goobz had the lineup to beat Rat and didn't start it. The optimal lineup was 139.86, and Rat scored 129.48.
body: This one stings. Rat beat Team Goobz 129.48 to 125.36, the closest game of the week. Kenneth Walker III went for 36.3 and Brock Purdy for 25.28. C.J. Stroud did everything he could for Goobz with 35.36. But D'Andre Swift was projected for 18.6, started and scored 3.1, while Caleb Douglas scored 13.0 and Seth McGowan 11.2 on the bench.

Start the right guys and Goobz score 139.86 and win by 10.38. Instead they're 4-5, in ninth place, and the bench crime officially cost them a W. Goobz host the 8-1 DBC's this week, projected 106.5 to 109.8. “The lineup was fine,” a team source said. “The lineup was also wrong.”

archive.title: Stone Cold Dons score 130 and lose anyway, and the streak hits seven
archive.dek: Only three teams scored more than Danny Stevens in Week 9, and one of them was his opponent. Seven straight losses ties the second-longest losing streak in league history.
body: Danny Stevens finally showed up with a real score. Matthew Golden went for 32.4, Dak Prescott 19.5, and the Stone Cold Dons put up 130.0, the fourth-best score of the week. Too bad Vert put up 144.38 behind Ja'Marr Chase (31.5) and Javonte Williams (22.4). The Dons lost by 14.38.

That's seven straight losses, which ties Matthew Reese's 2022–23 streak for the second-longest in LFPFFL history. Only Christopher Bosefski's 10 is longer. The Dons are 1-8 with the league's worst luck at −3.31 wins. Their all-play record is 56-61. Their playoff odds are 0.0%.
The streak can end this week against 2-7 The Park, which projects 116.6 to 99.7. A win would be the Dons' first since Week 2.

archive.title: Re-grades: the O'Dons still run the trade market, and The Overload goes 0-for-2
archive.dek: With Week 9's real scores in, every 2026 trade was re-graded. Zach O'Donoghue's 13 deals are +111.5 lineup points. The Stone Cold Dons are last at −227.0.
body: Every 2026 trade got re-graded with Week 9 actuals, and the numbers moved. The Fighting O'Dons still lead the league at +111.5 lineup points on 13 trades (C+). The anomaly’s are second at +96.8 on 11 (B-) and Trust The Process third at +89.9 on nine (B-). Big Dabolls have the best report card, a 3.12 GPA (B).

The bottom is a crime scene. The Stone Cold Dons are −227.0 on 14 trades (C-). Jalen rams me is −147.7 on 25 (C). The Overload made two trades and both are Fs: Trade No. 26 is −74.4 and Trade No. 47 is −55.6, for a 0.00 GPA. Two trades, two Fs. That's commitment.

Biggest flip: Trade No. 6, Brian Thomas Jr. and Kenneth Walker III to Brighton for Jalen Coker, Jeremiyah Love, Bo Nix and Tee Higgins. It's now an A for Jalen rams me (+35.7) and a D+ for Aaron Rodgers LSD (−18.3). Trade No. 37 also swung: a C for Brighton (−3.9) and an A- for Rat (+28.4). Trade No. 56 holds at a C- for Jalen rams me (−8.2) and a B- for the O'Dons (+3.6).

archive.title: Brighton's 25th trade: Charbonnet out, Stafford and an injured Pittman in
archive.dek: Jalen rams me grades a C- (-9.8) for paying a starting running back to get a QB who projects below waiver level, and the Fighting O'Dons take a B- (+3.8).
body: Trade No. 56 went through at 9:49 p.m. Friday. Brighton Caushaj's Jalen rams me sent Zach Charbonnet to the Fighting O'Dons for Matthew Stafford and Michael Pittman Jr. It's Brighton's 25th trade of the season, and this one is a damn mess. Kyler Murray projects for zero more points, so Jalen rams me went shopping for a quarterback and came back with Stafford: 11.22 in Week 9 and 116.0 projected the rest of the way, which is less than the waiver-level QB projects. Pittman put up zeros in Weeks 7 and 8 and projects for zero. That's not a throw-in, that's a bench-clogging souvenir.

The O'Dons get Charbonnet, who put up 9.6 in Week 9 and projects for 96.6 the rest of the way, plus a roster spot back. Lineup gain: -9.8 for Jalen rams me, a C-, and +3.8 for the O'Dons, a B-. That sinks Jalen rams me to -260.8 lineup points across 25 trades. The 6-3 O'Dons keep the top spot on the trade ledger at +233.3. Zach O'Donoghue just keeps winning these.

archive.title: Dons trade Dons: Antonio Williams goes to Stone Cold for Tyson
archive.dek: Trade No. 55 sends a 7.8-point-a-game receiver to the 1-7 Stone Cold Dons for a receiver who hasn't scored a point this season.
body: Trade No. 55 went through at 12:48 p.m. Friday, the first deal between the league's two Dons. Zach O'Donoghue's Fighting O'Dons sent Antonio Williams to Danny Stevens' Stone Cold Dons for Jordyn Tyson. Williams has 54.9 points in seven games, 7.84 a game, and scored 10.4 on the O'Dons' bench last week. Tyson has zero. He spent Weeks 6 through 8 in the Stone Cold Dons' IR slot and is still listed on injured reserve.

Neither lineup changes yet. Williams lands on the 1-7 Dons' bench projected for 10.1, a point more than flex starter Ryan Flournoy (9.0), with his new team down 27.5-0 to Vert after Thursday. Tyson goes to the 5-3 O'Dons' bench because Michael Pittman Jr. already has their IR spot. ESPN projects Williams for 97.3 more points this season and Tyson for 58.7. “It's a Dons thing,” a league source said. “You wouldn't understand.”

Grades: Stone Cold Dons B- (+2.8) and Fighting O'Dons C+ (0.0). Williams is worth a couple of points as Dons depth. Tyson doesn't crack the O'Dons' lineup in any week of the model. Congrats to the Dons on winning a trade, even if it's only by 2.8.

archive.title: Brighton's 24th trade ships Garrett Wilson to Rat after 46 hours
archive.dek: Jalen rams me gets Breece Hall and Ladd McConkey for Wilson and Carnell Tate, and Trust The Process trades for a quarterback it had cut that morning.
body: Trade No. 53 went through Thursday afternoon: Brighton Caushaj sent Garrett Wilson and Carnell Tate to Elijah Dembe's Rat for Breece Hall and Ladd McConkey. Wilson arrived from the anomaly's on Tuesday and left 46 hours later without playing a down for Jalen rams me. Both newcomers start right away against Big Dabolls, Hall at RB (10.9 projected) and McConkey at WR (10.8), with Big Dabolls already up 13.58-0 after Thursday night. Rat puts Wilson (14.2 a game, questionable) at flex; Tate is out and on the bench. It's Brighton's 24th trade of the season. "He doesn't build a roster, he leases one," a league source said.

Trade No. 54 was a quarterback round trip. Trust The Process added Deshaun Watson Wednesday, cut him Thursday morning, and watched the Stone Cold Dons pick him up by lunch. That evening John Reese sent Joe Fagnano, a same-day pickup, to the Dons to get Watson back, then cut Watson again at 10:53 p.m. Fagnano scored -0.3 on the Dons' bench Thursday night. Bo Nix stays TTP's starter. The lineup impact on both sides is zero, and so far that's the best number in the deal.

Grades: Rat gets a B (+7.3 lineup points) for Wilson and Tate. Jalen rams me gets a C (-2.9): Hall and McConkey help, but Tate's 112.8 projected rest-of-season points walk out the door. The Watson round trip grades C+ on both sides at a flat 0.0, because a quarterback nobody started can't move a lineup.

archive.title: Jaguars 33, Ravens 10: Vert banks 27.5, Henry and Flowers stall
archive.dek: Thursday night went to Jacksonville, and so did the league's points: Vert's kicker outscored every Raven in an LFPFFL lineup.
body: Cam Little kicked his way to 17.0 and Jakobi Meyers added 10.5, so Vert leads Stone Cold Dons 27.5-0 with seven starters left to nine. The Overload's Jaguars D/ST put up 12.0 for a 12.0-9.78 lead on the anomaly’s, whose Derrick Henry managed 5.58 against a 15.81 average.

Zay Flowers (5.3) still has Rat up 5.3-0 on Team Goobz, and Trevor Lawrence's 13.58 has Big Dabolls up on Jalen rams me. The best Raven went unused: Justice Hill scored 18.2 on The Park's bench, 4.1 more than starter Parker Washington. The Park leads the O'Dons 14.1-0 anyway. “We liked the matchup,” a team source said. “We just liked it from the bench.”

archive.title: The anomaly’s are 5-3 and have been outscored by 37.5 points
archive.dek: John Francis has the only winning record in the league with a negative point differential, and this week he gets the team built the opposite way.
body: The anomaly’s have scored 912.9 points and allowed 950.4. Every other team above .500 is in the black. The last three weeks average 92.8, and the latest win was a 2.76-point escape from Brighton.

This week it’s The Overload: 3-5, plus-53.8, third in the league in points and second-unluckiest at −2.15 wins. The projections have Trevor by 9.0 and at 61% to win, with Jahmyr Gibbs (26.5) the anomaly’s’ best hope. “We don’t look at point differential,” a team source said. “We look at the standings. The standings are going great.”

archive.title: LFPFFL plans spring election for commissioner, punishment committee, Instagram
archive.dek: League sources say managers will vote in March or April 2027 to fill five offices: a commissioner, three punishment-committee seats and the league's first Instagram manager.
body: The LFPFFL is heading to the polls. According to people familiar with the planning, the offseason vote will fill a single commissioner seat, a three-person punishment committee and a brand-new Instagram manager job. Nobody can say yet whether one person can hold two offices.

Early names are already circulating. Elijah Dembe is the first name floated for the punishment committee, a week after Rat put up 53.06. Nobody knows the subject better. For commissioner, both Johns are in the mix, John Reese and John Francis, which would at least keep the ballot simple. And Matthew Reese has reportedly asked for the Instagram job. The Park is 2-6, which leaves plenty of Sundays open for content.
Term lengths and campaign rules are still undecided. "Nothing is settled," one manager said, "except that nobody's running unopposed."

archive.title: The 4-4 logjam all lost Sunday, and 3-5 Overload likes its odds
archive.dek: Seeds 7 through 10 went a combined 0-4 in Week 8, while the team below them has better playoff odds than any of them.
body: Trust The Process, Team Goobz, Rat and Jalen rams me all lost in Week 8 and sit at 4-4, holding seeds 7 through 10 on points alone. Their playoff odds run from 65.2% (Goobz) down to 11.3% (Jalen rams me). Rat and Goobz play each other Sunday, so one of them leaves the logjam either way.

One spot back, The Overload is 3-5 with 985.7 points, third in the league, and a 67-37 all-play record. The simulations give Trevor Illson's team 78.5% playoff odds, better than all four 4-4 teams and 5-3 Aaron Rodgers LSD (70.3%). "We're the best 3-5 team in America," a team source said. Nobody has checked.

archive.title: Week 8's zero club: six starters, five teams, one survivor
archive.dek: Lamar Jackson, Zay Flowers and four others put up nothing Sunday, and only The Overload won anyway.
body: Six starters finished Week 8 with exactly 0.0 points, and they were projected for 85.1 combined. Lamar Jackson (22.2 projected) and Zay Flowers (20.1) led the walk-ons; Team Goobz lost by 50.48 and Rat by 90.72. Stone Cold Dons doubled up with Omar Cooper Jr. and Tez Johnson and lost by 46.76 to fall to 1-7. Trust The Process got nothing from kicker Will Reichard and 1.4 from Baker Mayfield in a 142.18-108 loss to A-Rock Balls.

The lone survivor: The Overload started Tre Tucker, got zero, and beat Stone Cold Dons 120.26-73.5 anyway. "We consider him a decoy," a team source said. The league office says the zero club meets weekly. Attendance has been strong.

archive.title: Bo Nix grades out a C- for Trust The Process; Brighton wins
archive.dek: Trades No. 51 and 52 are graded: John Reese's new quarterback projects below replacement level, and Brighton takes the four-player swap with the anomaly's.
body: Trust The Process started Baker Mayfield in Week 8 and got 1.4 points. With Jalen Hurts on IR, John Reese sent Khalil Shakir to Aaron Rodgers LSD for Bo Nix. The lineup math is brutal: Nix projects 14.76 a week, the league's replacement-level QB (the 15th-best rostered) projects 15.77. That's -9.1 over the rest of the season and a C- for TTP. LSD gets a C+ at 0.0: Caleb Williams (17.03) stays under center and Shakir (10.24) doesn't crack their projected lineup. Nobody got fleeced, but nobody got better either.

Four hours later Brighton Caushaj won his swap with John Francis. Jalen rams me gets Garrett Wilson and Malik Washington for Jaylen Waddle and Braelon Allen, and Wilson (11.95 a week) slides into a lineup where Allen (9.16) used to be. Brighton: +10.7, a B. The anomaly's: -12.4, a D+, with Waddle (10.50) taking Wilson's starting spot. Allen spent four days in Brighton and leaves with a D+ stapled to his new team's ledger.

archive.title: On Brighton's schedule, 13 of 14 teams would be .500 or better
archive.dek: Jalen rams me is 4-4 against the league's second-softest schedule. Give it to everyone else and only one team finishes under .500.
body: Brighton Caushaj's opponents have averaged 102.2 points a week (817.5 total), the second-easiest schedule in the league. Only Holden Wright's (812.0) has been softer. We gave every team Jalen rams me's eight opponents and replayed the season.

The DBC's go 8-0. Fighting O'Dons and the anomaly's go 7-1. Vert, Trust The Process and the Overload go 6-2, which would move Trevor up from 3-5. Stone Cold Dons go from 1-7 to 5-3, and A-Rock (2-6) and Aaron Rodgers LSD finish 5-3 too. Team Goobz, Big Dabolls and Rat land at 4-4, alongside Brighton himself. Only The Park does worse, at 3-5.

Brighton has scored 792.5 points, second-fewest in the league. The schedule is doing the heavy lifting; Brighton is doing the trading. (When a team would have played itself, it gets Jalen rams me's score that week instead.)

archive.title: 143.78 to 53.06: the O'Dons just put up the biggest blowout in LFPFFL history
archive.dek: A 90.72-point beatdown breaks Goobz's 2025 record. Rat's 53.06 is the third-lowest score the league has ever seen.
body: Holy hell. Zach O'Donoghue beat Elijah Dembe by 90.72 points, wiping out the old blowout record of 89.38 (Goobz over A-Rock, Week 12 of 2025). Joe Burrow threw up 39.5, Bucky Irving added 21.0 and DJ Moore 16.6. That's four straight wins for the O'Dons, who are 5-3 and averaging 143.3 over the last three weeks.

Rat's 53.06 is the third-lowest score in league history, behind Danny Stevens' 50.6 in 2022 and Brighton's 51.84 in Week 1 this year. Zay Flowers scored zero. Jacoby Brissett scored 3.5. Jordan Mason 2.0, Tyler Higbee 2.4, Trey Smack 3.0, Rashod Bateman 3.2. Meanwhile Emmett Johnson put up 25.3 on the bench. The Commanders D/ST led all Rat starters with 14.
Even the best possible Rat lineup scored 78.36 and still loses by 65. That's not a bad week, that's a crime scene.

archive.title: The Overload benched 37.3 points and STILL won by 46
archive.dek: Harold Fannin scored 23.4 on the bench. Trevor's best lineup was 157.56, higher than anybody scored all week.
body: Trevor Illson beat Stone Cold Dons 120.26 to 73.5 and somehow made it look like a disappointment. Harold Fannin Jr. dropped 23.4 from the bench while Dallas Goedert started and scored 7.2. Wan'Dale Robinson had 15.7 on the bench while Tre Tucker (0) and Drake London (1.8) started. The optimal Overload lineup was 157.56. The highest real score of the week was 143.78.
Josh Allen (26.6) and Chuba Hubbard (24.9) carried the actual lineup. The Overload is 3-5 with the third-most points in the league, and the sims still give Trevor a 78.5% playoff shot.
Danny Stevens is 1-7 and has lost six straight, tying the third-longest skid in league history. Omar Cooper Jr. and Tez Johnson both started and both scored zero. Ryan Flournoy had 13.1 on the bench.

archive.title: Brighton loses by 2.76 with the winning points on his bench
archive.dek: Kenny Gainwell scored 14.0 on the pine. Zach Charbonnet started and scored 5.9. The anomaly's escape 118.06 to 115.3.
body: The closest game of Week 8 was decided before kickoff. Brighton Caushaj started Zach Charbonnet (5.9) over Kenny Gainwell (14.0). That swap alone is 8.1 points, almost three times the margin. Jalen rams me's best lineup was 124.0. They scored 115.3. John Francis won with 118.06.

The new guy delivered, at least. Braelon Allen, who came over from Big Dabolls on Friday, scored 23.3 in his first start, and Josh Jacobs added 23.2. Jahmyr Gibbs (24.8) led the anomaly's, who are 5-3.
Brighton is 4-4 with 11.3% playoff odds, and the schedule hands him Big Dabolls next. The bench is still undefeated.

archive.title: Holden's Oct. 27 deal flips from a C- to an A after one huge Sunday
archive.dek: Michael Wilson and Jonah Coleman put up 47.2 in their first week with Aaron Rodgers LSD. The Overload's side falls to a D.
body: The weekly trade re-grade has a new winner. A week ago, Holden Wright's swap with The Overload (Wan'Dale Robinson, Rachaad White and Marvin Harrison Jr. for Michael Wilson and Jonah Coleman) graded out as a C- for Holden. Then Wilson scored 26.8 and Coleman 20.4. Holden's side is now +43.5 for an A. Trevor Illson's side is −29.6, a D, with Robinson's 15.7 stuck on his bench and Harrison at zero.

Brighton's Friday deal with Big Dabolls (Luther Burden and Samaje Perine for A.J. Brown and Braelon Allen) is now a C+ on both sides, +0.8 for Brighton and +0.6 for Ben. Sunday's Courtland Sutton for Eli Raridon trade grades out as a B for Ben (+6.4) and a C+ for John Reese (0.0).
On the season ledger, the Fighting O'Dons lead at +229.5 over 11 deals. Jalen rams me (22 trades, −258.8) and Stone Cold Dons (12 trades, −276.2) bring up the rear.

archive.title: Aaron Rodgers LSD drops 134.88 on Goobz, and the new guys did it
archive.dek: Tee Higgins went for 37.5. Michael Wilson and Jonah Coleman, a week after arriving, added 47.2. Goobz started Lamar Jackson and got zero.
body: Holden Wright's team has been the league's favorite fraud all year. Not this week. Tee Higgins scored 37.5, Michael Wilson 26.8 and Jonah Coleman 20.4 in a 134.88 to 84.4 beatdown. Holden is 5-3 and his playoff odds nearly doubled, from 36.5% to 70.3%.

Team Goobz, meanwhile, set themselves on fire. Lamar Jackson started and scored zero. Tyler Allgeier scored 36.1 on the bench. Bijan Robinson managed 7.6. The best Goobz lineup was 115.7, which still loses, but by a lot less than 50.48.
Christopher Bosefski is 4-4, averaging 88.3 over the last three weeks, and his playoff odds just fell from 81.7% to 65.2%.

archive.title: The 7-1 DBC's get Trust The Process, fresh off a beating from A-Rock
archive.dek: lukas bosefski projects for 119.6, John Reese for 116.8. The DBC's are 75.2% to take the 1 seed.
body: The DBC's just ran over Big Dabolls 132.74 to 75.9 in last week's game of the week. Bhayshul Tuten scored 29.9, Puka Nacua 25.0 and Trey McBride 20.2. lukas bosefski leads the league in points (1,019.4) and all-play record (74-30).

Trust The Process is coming off a 142.18 to 108 loss to an A-Rock team that hadn't won since Week 1. Tony Pollard had 28.7 for Alex Reese. Baker Mayfield scored 1.4 for John, and Will Reichard scored zero. Jaxon Smith-Njigba did his part with 23.8.
The line is DBC's by 2.8, and the DBC's win 54% of the time. Nacua (24.1 projected) against Smith-Njigba (22.8) is the matchup to watch. Vote below.

archive.title: John Reese flips Courtland Sutton to Big Dabolls for Eli Raridon
archive.dek: Trade No. 50 of 2026 went through 17 minutes before Sunday's 1 p.m. kickoffs, and both players spent Week 8 on their new team's bench.
body: Sunday at 12:43 p.m., Trust The Process sent receiver Courtland Sutton to Ben Frey for tight end Eli Raridon. It's the first trade between the two franchises this season, and on paper it's a wash: both players average 6.0 points a game. Neither started in Week 8. Sutton scored 9.3 on the Big Dabolls' bench while DK Metcalf scored 1.4 at flex, and Raridon scored 1.5 behind Tucker Kraft. Both teams lost anyway, by 34.18 and 56.84.

The point of the deal is depth. Metcalf is projected for zero in Week 9, so Sutton (8.9 projected) is in Frey's flex conversation against Jalen rams me, the team he traded with on Friday. Reese now has two tight ends and seven receivers going into a game against the 7-1 DBC's. "Everybody needs a TE2," a team source said. Kraft is projected for 10.7.

archive.title: WTF is going on with Rat
archive.dek: Elijah Dembe has 39.06 points and one player left. The lowest score in LFPFFL history is 50.6.
body: Rat's only player left is the Commanders D/ST, projected for 6.9. That puts Elijah Dembe on pace for about 46 points, which would break Danny Stevens' all-time low of 50.6 from Week 6 of 2022. To stay out of the record book, the Commanders need at least 11.6 points. They've averaged 3.8 this year.

How it happened: Zay Flowers was projected for 20.1 and scored zero. Jacoby Brissett started at quarterback and scored 3.5. Jordan Mason had 2.0, Tyler Higbee 2.4 and Trey Smack 3.0. Emmett Johnson scored 25.3, more than any Rat starter, from the bench.

Across the field, Zach O'Donoghue has 119.88 with three players left and projects to about 146. If that holds, the margin would also beat the blowout record, Goobz's 89.38 over A-Rock in 2025. Two records, one Sunday. Both teams came in 4-3.

archive.title: Brighton trails The anomaly’s by 10.36, needs Lemon and Charbonnet
archive.dek: Week 8's only live game goes through Philadelphia tonight and Seattle on Monday; the other six are mostly paperwork.
body: Brighton Caushaj's Jalen rams me sit at 97.70, 10.36 behind John Francis and The anomaly’s (108.06), two 4-3 teams with a grudge from Thursday. Brighton has Makai Lemon (10.2 projected) tonight and Zach Charbonnet (10.4) Monday. Francis has only the Bears D/ST (5.8), also Monday. ESPN projects 118.30 to 113.86, Brighton.

Trevor Illson leads Danny Stevens 86.26-73.50 with three starters left; Stevens is finished. Samuel Vert has 112.88 to Matthew Reese's final 87.96 despite benching Patrick Mahomes' 25.44. Alex Reese leads John Reese 127.20-84.20 with Jayden Daniels still to play.
The rest are over. Christopher Bosefski trails Holden Wright 120.90-54.50 with Tyler Allgeier's 36.1 on his bench. "We'll look at it," a team source said.

archive.title: Saquon Barkley, traded five times, asks O'Dons for a no-trade clause
archive.dek: The Fighting O'Dons are his fourth team and sixth stop of 2026. On Sunday he faces Rat, stop No. 2.
body: Sources say Barkley's camp approached Zach O'Donoghue this week about a no-trade clause, which the LFPFFL does not have. Barkley went 16th overall to The Park and has since been dealt to Rat, Jalen rams me, back to The Park, back to Jalen rams me and, on Oct. 14, to the O'Dons. He has 38.1 points this season, 7.6 a game, just behind bench back Rico Dowdle's 8.3. He's questionable and still in Sunday's lineup against Rat. "He just wants to unpack," a league source said.

archive.title: Draft retro: The Overload drafted well and went 2-5 anyway
archive.dek: Trevor Illson's seventh-round pick Chuba Hubbard has outscored Ja'Marr Chase and Drake London, and 15th-rounder Jordan Love is second among drafted quarterbacks.
body: Through Thursday night, the top of the 2026 draft board has aged unevenly. De'Von Achane went 12th overall and has 24.6 points; he's on IR and on waivers. A.J. Brown went 21st, scored 19.1 and was traded Friday. The late rounds were kinder. Jordan Love went 205th overall to Big Dabolls and has 148.8 points, second among drafted quarterbacks.

The best draft may belong to a 2-5 team. The Overload took Josh Allen 35th (161.3 points, first among drafted QBs) and Chuba Hubbard 91st (133.0, more than Drake London at 13th or Ja'Marr Chase at 3rd). Eleventh-rounder Tre Tucker has 99.8. Trevor's team has the third-most points in the league and two wins. "The draft was the easy part," a team source said.

archive.title: The anomaly’s Oct. 14 trade haul is sitting together on the bench
archive.dek: Justin Herbert, Keenan Allen and Tyreek Hill came over from the O'Dons for Matthew Stafford. None of them is starting in Week 8.
body: Two weeks after John Francis sent Matthew Stafford and Dohnte Meyers to the Fighting O'Dons, the entire return is on the bench. Herbert (10.4 a game) sits behind Bryce Young (18.0). Keenan Allen (10.1) can't crack a lineup that starts Tetairoa McMillan and Garrett Wilson. Tyreek Hill has zero points this season.

Team sources say the three have started sitting together at practice. "Veteran presence," Francis said when asked what they bring. He has made 10 trades this season, and five of his seven bench spots are now receivers. Hill's locker, one source noted, is the cleanest on the team.

archive.title: Luther Burden gets his wish: Brighton ships him to Big Dabolls
archive.dek: Trade No. 22: Burden and Samaje Perine go to Ben Frey for A.J. Brown and Braelon Allen, two days after the Rumor Mill said Burden wanted out.
body: Wednesday, the Wire reported Luther Burden wanted out of Jalen rams me. By Friday at noon he was gone: Brighton Caushaj sent Burden (13.9 a game) and Samaje Perine to Big Dabolls for A.J. Brown and Braelon Allen. It's Brighton's 22nd trade of the season. We had Big Dabolls at "everyone else, +1000."

Thursday's report that Ben Frey's patience with A.J. Brown was running out turned out to be accurate. Brown is questionable again and averaging 6.4 a game. The lineup math still likes Brighton's side, +7.1 points the rest of the way for a B, because Brown projects for 151 more points, the most of anyone in the deal. Ben takes a C- (−7.1) and a receiver who actually shows up.
Both teams are mid-game. Big Dabolls leads the DBC's 17.3 to 9.6, and Jalen rams me is up on the anomaly's 23.2 to 22.2.

archive.title: Christian Watson went to the hospital, then came back for 113 yards
archive.dek: Thursday's Packers-Panthers game touched nine LFPFFL rosters, and Ben Frey's receiver took an ambulance ride in the middle of it.
body: Watson caught a 53-yarder in the first half, took a hit to the chest and left in an ambulance for precautionary tests. He was back by the third quarter and finished with 8 catches for 113 yards. That's a strong start to Big Dabolls' first-place showdown with the DBC's, who answered with Jalen Coker's 26-yard touchdown on fourth down. Jordan Love threw for 288 yards and three scores, from Ben's bench.

Brighton had the best night. Josh Jacobs ran for just 39 yards and still scored twice, on a run and a catch. Two days after Jalen rams me's coach supposedly fired shots at the anomaly's, John Francis watched Bryce Young get sacked six times (209 yards, 1 TD, 1 INT).

Elsewhere: Tucker Kraft caught a touchdown for Trust The Process. The Overload-Stone Cold Dons game is even, with Chuba Hubbard (81 rushing yards, a TD, 7 catches) for Trevor and Matthew Golden (7 for 79 and a TD) for Danny. Rat's kicker, Trey Smack, missed an extra point. The Park's Panthers D picked off Love once and gave up 27.

archive.title: Jalen rams me coach fires shots at the anomaly’s before Sunday
archive.dek: Asked about facing the anomaly’s head coach this week, the Jalen rams me coach kept it to five words, and three of them needed asterisks.
body: Asked Thursday how he felt about going up against the anomaly’s head coach, the Jalen rams me coach didn't need long. "F*ck that soft a** b*tch," he said, and left the podium. A team spokesman later said the comments "speak for themselves."

The numbers don't exactly back him up. Jalen rams me is 4-3 on a three-game win streak, but its 677.2 points rank 13th in the league. The anomaly’s are also 4-3, with 794.8, and are projected to win 126.7 to 104.6, with 73% win odds. Their locker room held a players-only meeting Tuesday. Now it has a new topic.

archive.title: Ben Frey's patience with A.J. Brown is running out
archive.dek: Brown is questionable again, his backup is on bye, and the Big Dabolls play the 6-1 DBC's on Sunday.
body: Sources describe Ben Frey as "beyond frustrated" with A.J. Brown, his draft-day receiver, who is listed questionable again and is averaging 6.4 points a game across three appearances. The obvious fix would be Devaughn Vele, who scored 16.4 in Week 7 and averages 12.3. Vele is on bye.

So if Brown sits, the likeliest plan is moving DK Metcalf into his spot and starting a tight end, Eli Raridon (projected 7.8), at flex. "I drafted a wide receiver," Frey said, staring at the injury report. "I'd love to see one."

archive.title: Goobz's newest stars can't help, so Treylon Burks gets the flex
archive.dek: Christopher Bosefski traded for Davante Adams and David Montgomery within a week. This week they're projected for a combined zero.
body: Adams (17.0 a game) arrived from Stone Cold Dons on Oct. 24 and is on IR. Montgomery (9.1 a game) came over from Jalen rams me on Tuesday and is projected for zero in Week 8. So as of Thursday, the flex spot belongs to Treylon Burks, a waiver pickup from the same day as the Adams deal, at 7.2 a game. "We're built for December," Bosefski said.
Team Goobz (4-3) face Aaron Rodgers LSD (4-3) on Sunday. Burks is listed questionable.

archive.title: The anomaly’s call players-only meeting after two-game skid
archive.dek: After 70.92 points against Rat, sources say the locker room decided it was time to talk, and the coaching staff wasn't invited.
body: The anomaly’s held a players-only meeting Tuesday, according to a league source, after scoring 89.44 and 70.92 in back-to-back losses that dropped John Francis's team to 4-3. Two weeks earlier, the same group put up 153.82. Nine of the 16 players on the roster arrived by trade, and the meeting reportedly opened with introductions.

Jahmyr Gibbs, averaging 28.5 a game, is said to have done most of the talking. "We've got Justin Herbert on the bench," one player in the room said. "Think about that." Next up is Jalen rams me, also 4-3. The door stayed closed. Francis was heard knocking.

archive.title: Luther Burden wants OUT of Jalen rams me
archive.dek: Twelve days after arriving in the Amon-Ra deal, the hottest piece of Brighton's haul has asked for a trade. Sources say he found out about the other 20 trades.
body: Do the math. Burden came over from Vert on Oct 16 as part of the St. Brown blockbuster, dropped 23.7 in his Jalen rams me debut, and is averaging 13.9 a game this season. Then he looked around the locker room. Josh Jacobs got here the same day. Josh Downs got here last night. David Montgomery left last night. Brighton Caushaj has made 21 trades this year, and his ledger is −163 lineup points. Nobody unpacks in this building. Burden's camp reportedly wants 'stability,' which in this league means a manager with fewer than ten trades.

Brighton's problem: Burden is his WR1. His 145 rest-of-season points are the best of any receiver on the roster, ahead of Carnell Tate (121) and Jaylen Waddle (112). Moving him for anything less than a starter blows a hole in a 4-3 team. Moving him at all is trade number 22. You know he's taking calls.

THE BOARD. Front-runner: The DBC's (+200). lukas bosefski is 6-1 with Puka Nacua and Jalen Coker, but his WR3 is KC Concepcion (111 ROS), and he has made exactly two trades all year. Fresh blood, deep pockets, a title to chase. Next up: Aaron Rodgers LSD (+300). Holden has three receivers on the whole roster after consolidating into Michael Wilson; one bye week and he's starting a ghost. Fighting O'Dons (+400): Zach O'Donoghue has never seen a trade he didn't like, 11 of them and +166 points on the ledger, so never count him out. Team Goobz (+600): Christopher Bosefski just fleeced Brighton for Montgomery and might want seconds. Everyone else: +1000. Stone Cold Dons need him most (WR2 is Omar Cooper Jr. at 98) but at 1-6 they're buying lottery tickets, not receivers.

archive.title: Three deals in 24 hours: Trevor goes shopping, Goobz steals Montgomery
archive.dek: The Overload takes Rachaad White, Wan'Dale Robinson and Marvin Harrison Jr. off Holden's hands. Team Goobz flips Josh Downs for David Montgomery. Brighton makes it 21.
body: Trevor Illson is 2-5 and done waiting. He sent Michael Wilson and Jonah Coleman to Holden Wright for White, Robinson and MHJ, and the lineup math likes it: +8.9 points the rest of the way, a B. Holden consolidates into Wilson and gets a C- for his trouble. Trevor's new strategy: buy everything.

Best deal of the bunch: Team Goobz (+18.1, B+). Christopher Bosefski turned Josh Downs into David Montgomery, a real RB2. Brighton Caushaj takes the C- (−7.2) on trade number 21. His trade ledger is now −163 points. Somebody take this man's phone.
Also on the wire: Trust The Process swapped Konata Mumpfield for Malachi Fields with The DBC's. +1.2 / −1.2. Both sides get a C+, a wash.

archive.title: Ben Frey leaves 34 points on the pine and hands Goobz a win
archive.dek: Lost by 5.4. Benched 34.1. Started a Texans defense that scored zero. Do the math, Ben, because you clearly didn't.
body: Big Dabolls walked into Week 7 at 5-1 and walked out at 5-2 with a fresh hole in the foot. Christopher Bosefski won 91.02 to 85.66, which is the kind of score that should get both teams fined.

The optimal Ben lineup scored 119.8. Cam Skattebo put up 19.1 on the bench while the Texans D/ST started and posted a clean, beautiful 0. That's the biggest bench blunder of the week, and it flipped a W into an L.
Ben's still 5-2, still third in the power rankings, and still the luckiest team in the top four (+1.2 wins above his scoring). The universe is starting to send invoices.

archive.title: Tony Pollard drops 36.5 and A-Rock still loses. Six straight, baby
archive.dek: Week 7's best player scored for the league's worst team. Zach O'Donoghue didn't care and put up 148.
body: Alex Reese finally got a monster game: Tony Pollard went for 36.5, the top individual score in the league this week. Alex put up 122.5, his best total of the season.
Zach O'Donoghue answered with 148.08, the high score of the week, behind Joe Burrow's 28.9. Fighting O'Dons have won three straight and sit second in the power rankings.
A-Rock is 1-6 with a 1.4% playoff chance. At this point Pollard should file for a trade request.

archive.title: Danny Stevens scores 129.7 and loses AGAIN. Somebody check on this man
archive.dek: Fourth-best score of the week. Still an L. Danny is 1-6 with the scoring of a 3.5-win team.
body: Stone Cold Dons put up 129.68, good enough to beat 10 of the 13 other teams in Week 7. The schedule gods sent him the DBC's, who hung 135.02.

Danny is tied with Trevor Illson for the unluckiest team in the league: −2.46 wins below what his scoring has earned. Against the weekly median he's 3-4. In real life he's 1-6, and his playoff odds are 0.4%.
Five straight losses. The man needs a hug, a priest, and a new schedule.

archive.title: The DBC's are 6-1 and nobody can touch them
archive.dek: Second year in the league, last year's runner-up, and now the clear title favorite. Trey McBride hung 27.1.
body: lukas bosefski is running the most complete team in the LFPFFL. Best all-play record (64-27), most points (886.6), best record (6-1), and a 72% chance at the No. 1 seed.
Trey McBride, already a first-ballot Hall of Famer for this franchise, went for 27.1 in the win over Danny. Puka Nacua projects 22.4 next week.
Next up: Ben Frey in the game of the week. If the DBC's win, start engraving.

archive.title: Rat wins with 85 points in the ugliest game of the year
archive.dek: Elijah Dembe 85.12, John Francis 70.92. Both teams should have to forfeit their draft picks.
body: The anomaly's put up 70.9, the lowest score of Week 7, and Rat beat them with 85.1, which is the third-lowest winning score of the entire 2026 season.
Rat is 4-3 but sits ninth in the power rankings with a .429 all-play record. Good luck charm, bad football team.
John Francis has the toughest schedule in the league so far. This week, he was his own toughest opponent.

archive.title: Brighton Caushaj is 4-3 with the 13th-best offense. How?
archive.dek: 99.4 beats Matthew Reese's 96.5. That's three straight wins for a team that scores like it's allergic to points.
body: Brighton has scored 677.2 points, 13th of 14. His all-play record is 35-56. Against the weekly median he'd be 2-5. He is 4-3.
Our math puts the odds of a team with his scores being 4-3 or better at about 23%. He's been dodging bullets like Neo.
His model-based playoff odds are 18%. Next week he's a 22-point underdog to John Francis. The bill is coming.

archive.title: Vert flattens Holden by 39.7
archive.dek: The biggest blowout of Week 7. Holden started a tight end who scored zero and benched Bo Nix's 26.2.
body: Samuel Vert won 122.9 to 83.2. Ja'Marr Chase and friends did the work; Vert has the best rest-of-season roster in the league by projection.
Holden Wright started Will Mallory at tight end and got a goose egg. Bo Nix scored 26.2 on his bench. It wouldn't have saved him, but damn.
Holden is 4-3 with the scoring of a 2.7-win team. The fraud alarm is ringing.

archive.title: Trust The Process tops The Overload; Trevor's skid hits four
archive.dek: John Reese 133.86, Trevor Illson 125.72. Jaxon Smith-Njigba went for 31.3.
body: Trust The Process has won three straight and posted its best score of the year. JSN is averaging 28.0 points a game.

Trevor Illson is the unluckiest team in football: 2-5 with the third-most points scored and a 5-2 record against the weekly median. The defending champ has a 64% playoff chance despite the record, because his roster is legit.
Trevor's schedule has been a crime scene. He'll be a 22-point favorite against Danny next week.
